name: LogicVol Experiment A: can a Regression Tsetlin Machine forecast next-week volatility?
hypothesis: A Regression Tsetlin Machine on train-only Boolean features forecasts next-week SPY volatility better than simple historical estimates and close to a HAR-style model.

data.source: Tiingo current-vintage adjusted daily closes (internal use only)

target.definition: log of annualised realised volatility over the next 5 sessions: y_t = 0.5 * log(252 * mean(r_{t+1}^2 .. r_{t+5}^2))
target.returns: daily close-to-close log returns of adjusted closes
target.decision_time: after the close of day t; every feature uses data up to and including day t
target.note: Daily-return volatility, not intraday realised volatility, so the benchmark is called HAR-style, not HAR-RV.

groups.har_components: realised volatility over the last 1, 5 and 22 sessions (and 66), in logs
groups.vol_change: 5-session vol divided by 66-session vol; 22-session vol divided by 66-session vol
groups.returns: 5- and 22-session returns; drawdown from the 100-session high; absolute return today
groups.cross_asset: TLT 22-session vol; 60-session SPY-TLT return correlation; IWM minus SPY 22-session vol

features.booleanisation: thermometer encoding at train-only deciles (q10..q90), refit on each training window
features.excluded_until_v0.2: VIX (not in the current data; it is required as a baseline before any claim of practical usefulness)

models.historical_22: forecast = log realised vol of the last 22 sessions
models.har_style: OLS of y on log vol over 1, 5 and 22 sessions, fit on the training window
models.ridge_boolean: ridge regression on the same Boolean features the TM sees (isolates the model from the encoding)
models.tm_regression: tmu TMRegressor on the Boolean features

tm_settings.selection: per fold, choose the candidate with the lowest QLIKE on the last 20% of that fold's training window; the test fold is never used for selection
tm_settings.target_scaling: y is min-max scaled on the training window only; the scaler is stored with each fold
tm_settings.fold_seed: seed + fold index (same convention as risk-audit-v0.3)

holdout.status: locked; run once only after this file is final

evaluation.walk_forward: expanding window, minimum 756 sessions of training, refit every 126 sessions
evaluation.purge: drop the last 5 training rows before each test fold, because their targets overlap the test period

metrics.primary: QLIKE on variance: rv2/h2 - log(rv2/h2) - 1. Models fit to mean log-volatility (har_style, ridge_boolean, tm_regression) are converted to a variance forecast with the log-normal correction h2 = exp(2*yhat + 2*s2), where s2 is the residual variance on the held-back last 20% of each training window (model fit on the first part, with the purge gap). historical_22 and ewma are variance estimators and are not corrected. Uncorrected QLIKE is also reported.
secondary: recall of the top-decile volatility weeks

implementation.ewma_seed: mean of the first 22 squared returns
implementation.data_file: a development-only copy made with `logic-alpha logicvol-cut`; the runner also drops any row after the development end before computing anything
implementation.amended_before_any_run: 2026-11-05: added weighted_clauses (unweighted clauses cap the output at the clause count, below T for two candidates), the numeric walk-forward fields, ridge_alpha, variance floor and fold seed rule. No results existed when these were added.
implementation.amendment_2: 2026-11-05: added the log-normal correction for QLIKE. Found after one baselines-only run (--skip-tm), in which har_style had the lowest MSE of log volatility but a worse QLIKE than ewma because a mean-log forecast underestimates variance. The correction is the textbook one, applied identically to all log-fitted models, and was decided before any Tsetlin Machine result existed.

pass: median QLIKE of the 3 TM seeds is lower than historical_22 and lower than ewma
median QLIKE of the 3 TM seeds is at most 5% worse than har_style
every TM seed is at most 10% worse than har_style
decision_rule.on_pass: run Experiment B (clause extraction and stability across folds and seeds), then Experiment C (volatility-targeted exposure backtest)
decision_rule.on_fail: write the result in RESULTS.md and stop; no tuning on the test folds and no integration work

selection_policy: Report every seed and every asset. Do not pick the best seed. The robustness assets are reported but do not decide pass or fail.
limitations: Current-vintage adjusted data; daily-return volatility is a noisy proxy for true volatility; no VIX or implied-volatility baseline in v0.1; the development period was already used by earlier LogicAlpha experiments for strategy selection, not for volatility.
